{

	"description": "A simple task app with a progress bar",

	"main": "dist/main/index.cjs",

	"author": {
		"name": "Cassidy Williams",
		"email": "hi@cassidoo.co",
		"url": "https://cassidoo.co"
	},

		"type": "git",
		"url": "https://github.com/cassidoo/todometer"
	},
	"build": {
		"appId": "co.cassidoo.todometer",
		"productName": "todometer",
		"copyright": "Copyright © 2026 @cassidoo",
		"publish": {
			"provider": "github",
			"owner": "cassidoo",
			"repo": "todometer",
			"releaseType": "release"
		},
		"afterSign": "scripts/notarize.js",
		"mac": {
			"category": "public.app-category.utilities",

				"dmg",
				"zip"
			],
			"hardenedRuntime": true,
			"gatekeeperAssess": false,
			"entitlements": "build/entitlements.mac.plist",
			"entitlementsInherit": "build/entitlements.mac.inherit.plist",
			"notarize": false
		},
		"dmg": {

		},
		"win": {
			"icon": "assets/win/icon.ico",
			"target": [
				"nsis"
			]
		},

			"oneClick": false,
			"allowToChangeInstallationDirectory": true,
			"perMachine": false
		},
		"linux": {

			"icon": "assets/png/256.png"

		"files": [
			"node_modules/**/*",
			"dist/main/**",
			"dist/preload/**",
			"dist/renderer/**",

			"assets/logo.svg",
			"package.json"
		],
		"extraResources": [
			{
				"from": "src/mcp/index.mjs",
				"to": "mcp/index.mjs"

		"directories": {
			"buildResources": "assets"
		},
		"protocols": {
			"name": "todometer",
			"schemes": [
				"todometer"
			]
		}
	},
	"scripts": {
		"dev": "node src/scripts/watch.mjs",
		"build": "npm run build:main & npm run build:preload & npm run build:renderer",
		"update-vendors": "cross-env ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1 electron src/scripts/update-electron-vendors.mjs",
		"build:main": "cd ./src/main && vite build",
		"build:preload": "cd ./src/preload && vite build",
		"build:renderer": "cd ./src/renderer && vite build",
		"test": "cd ./src/renderer && vitest run src",
		"test:watch": "cd ./src/renderer && vitest src",
		"postinstall": "electron-builder install-app-deps && npm run update-vendors",

name: Release

on:
  push:
    tags:
      - "v*"

permissions:
  contents: write

jobs:
  release-mac:
    runs-on: macos-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 24
          cache: npm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Build
        run: npm run pre-electron-pack

      - name: Import macOS signing certificate
        env:
          MACOS_CERTIFICATE: ${{ secrets.MACOS_CERTIFICATE }}
          MACOS_CERTIFICATE_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.MACOS_CERTIFICATE_PASSWORD }}
        run: |
          echo "$MACOS_CERTIFICATE" | base64 --decode > certificate.p12
          security create-keychain -p actions build.keychain
          security default-keychain -s build.keychain
          security unlock-keychain -p actions build.keychain
          security import certificate.p12 -k build.keychain -P "$MACOS_CERTIFICATE_PASSWORD" -T /usr/bin/codesign
          security set-key-partition-list -S apple-tool:,apple:,codesign: -s -k actions build.keychain
          rm certificate.p12

      - name: Build and publish macOS
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          APPLE_ID: ${{ secrets.APPLE_ID }}
          APPLE_APP_SPECIFIC_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.APPLE_APP_SPECIFIC_PASSWORD }}
          APPLE_TEAM_ID: ${{ secrets.APPLE_TEAM_ID }}
        run: npm run pack:mac -- --publish always

  release-win:
    runs-on: windows-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 24
          cache: npm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Build
        run: npm run pre-electron-pack

      - name: Build and publish Windows
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          WIN_CSC_LINK: ${{ secrets.WIN_CSC_LINK }}
          WIN_CSC_KEY_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.WIN_CSC_KEY_PASSWORD }}
        run: npm run pack:win -- --publish always

  release-linux:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 24
          cache: npm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Build
        run: npm run pre-electron-pack

      - name: Build and publish Linux
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: npm run pack:linux -- --publish always

# This workflow warns and then closes issues and PRs that have had no activity for a specified amount of time.
#
# You can adjust the behavior by modifying this file.
# For more information, see:
# https://github.com/actions/stale
name: Mark stale issues and pull requests

on:
  schedule:
  - cron: '36 23 * * *'

jobs:
  stale:

    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      pull-requests: write

    steps:
    - uses: actions/stale@v5
      with:
        repo-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        stale-pr-message: 'This pull request is now considered stale! 😭'
        stale-pr-label: 'stale'
